wording: QUALIFIED for retained P2-32/P2-64 under D-P2-PAYLOAD-C, with provenance source-derived, metric-invariant (not observed). Unconditional D allocation/null filtering, group clipping and P suffix trimming bound every READ on one TP rank pair to 46 selected pages × 1,002,240 B = 46,103,040 B; structural 39,521,664 B is preserved. The adopted H200 pair prices this bound at 0.9684023419505275 ms, below all 2,034 possible posting-step gaps (minima 18.72496532622958 / 24.380075962758763 ms). The bound is within the eight-pair measured grid (maximum 817,827,840 B/reader). At its smallest qualifying byte coordinate, 46,103,040 B/reader, all 1,440 reader trials from both tied prompt cases and all three passes are below both gaps, including the 12.554511427879333 ms maximum; no trials removed. In these configurations wire bytes reach only READ transfer time; operator wire-byte tracing is disabled and structural memory/ledger bytes remain fixed. Actual native final descriptor IDs/ranges/aliases remain unobserved. No H800, tracing-enabled or other workload/configuration qualification is claimed.
